niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there is no single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, geography, creative needs, and whether you want programmatic buying, direct-sold placements, or full creative + measurement services.

To help you choose quickly, here’s a practical approach plus recommended agency types and specific names to consider.

Which partner to pick by objective
- Big-brand national/global TV + full-funnel integration: go with a major holding-company media agency that has strong CTV practice (GroupM — Mindshare/Wavemaker/Essence, Omnicom Media Group — OMD/PHD, Publicis Media — Zenith/Spark Foundry, Dentsu — Carat/iProspect, IPG — UM/Initiative).
- Performance / direct-response CTV (lower-funnel KPI focus): look for digital-first shops or programmatic specialists that run The Trade Desk, Amobee, or DV360 buys and optimize to conversions/ROAS.
- Local or smaller budgets: boutique CTV agencies or local media buyers who have strong streaming publisher relationships and can manage targeted buys cost-effectively.
- Creative-first brand storytelling on big streaming platforms: agencies with cross-platform creative + dynamic ad capabilities (Innovid, creative teams inside big agencies, or integrated shops like VaynerMedia).
- Platform/direct-sold campaigns (Roku, Hulu, Amazon/Fire TV, Samsung, Verizon, Xumo): often handled by in-house platform ad-sales teams or by agencies with direct publisher relationships.

Well-known vendors and specialists to consider
- Holding-group media agencies: GroupM, OMD/PHD, Publicis Media, Dentsu, IPG — enterprise scale, cross-market reach, advanced measurement.
- Programmatic/tech partners (buy-side): The Trade Desk (DSP), Google DV360, Amobee.
- Creative/measurement/ad-serving specialists: Innovid (creative + measurement for CTV), Sizmek/Adform (ad serving), DoubleVerify/Moat (verification).
- Platform ad-sales: Roku OneView, Hulu/Disney Ad Sales, Amazon DSP, Samsung Ads, Xandr (now part of Microsoft/Azure in past), Magnite (SSP).
- Independent CTV specialists/boutiques: many regional/boutique firms focus solely on streaming — useful for tailored strategies and hands-on service.

How to evaluate agencies (quick checklist)
1. Proven CTV case studies and clients in your category.
2. Access to premium streaming inventory and SSP/publisher relationships.
3. Programmatic expertise and preferred DSPs (The Trade Desk, DV360, Amobee).
4. Creative capability for CTV (30–60s creative, interactive/dynamic ads).
5. Measurement & attribution approach (viewability, incremental lift tests, third-party verification).
6. Transparency on media fees, data usage, and reporting cadence.
7. Reporting granularity — device, household, frequency, conversion tracking.
8. Flexibility on testing (A/B creative, targeting strategies) and optimization cadence.

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 3–5 specific agencies tailored to your budget, target market and KPI (brand awareness, traffic, leads, ROAS).
- Provide an RFP checklist or sample questions to ask finalists.

Tell me: what are your campaign goals, target geography/audience, monthly media budget, and whether you already have creative assets?
